description:
Search file contents with regex. Set path explicitly and use include to narrow files. Returns paths and line numbers sorted by path/line; workspace paths are relative and external paths absolute.

Root-level generated/cache/log/build directories are skipped. Broad results may be incomplete and non-deterministic; use the reported truncation to narrow the query. Matches include comments and strings. Use semantic code tools when exact symbol references are required.
Unity generated roots such as Library, Temp, Obj, Logs, and Build* are skipped.

include.description: File pattern to include in the search (e.g. "*.cs", "Assets/**/Editor/*.cs")
